bottom_line: OPEC+ announces deeper production cuts to support oil prices, tightening supply outlook for energy-importing economies.
what_changed: OPEC+ agreed to extend and deepen voluntary production cuts by an additional 1.2 million barrels per day through Q2.
why_it_matters: Tighter supply directly affects crude benchmarks, refining margins, and downstream energy costs for industrial buyers and transport sectors.
main_uncertainty: Compliance varies widely among members; actual production cuts may fall short of announced targets.

scenarios.name: Full compliance
scenarios.description: Members adhere to cuts; Brent rises above $90.
indicators: OPEC secondary source data confirms cuts

scenarios.name: Quota cheating
scenarios.description: Key members exceed quotas; price support erodes within weeks.
